doc.name: Sage Learning Printables
doc.instructions:
Free printable learning pages from Sage Teacher for parents and teachers of children ages 4-8 (grades K-2). Everything in this catalog is free to print, with no sign-in.

The catalog has Sage's daily color-by-number math printables, each inspired by a day in history: an event, an invention, a work of art, a feast day or a holiday. Use search_printables to find sheets by topic words, tag or date (today=true for today's sheet), and get_printable for one sheet's full details.

Give the adult the pageUrl: that page has Print and Download buttons. imageUrl is the full worksheet PNG with its color key. These pages are for an adult to print for a child; speak to the parent or teacher, not to the child.

tools.name: search_printables
tools.title: Search printables
tools.description: Search Sage's free color-by-number math printables for ages 4-8 (grades K-2). Newest first when browsing, most relevant first with a query. Each result has an id for get_printable, a pageUrl to print or download from, and imageUrl, the worksheet PNG. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for more.

query.description: Words to look for in the title, topic, tags, historical event and description, like 'moon landing' or 'saints'. Omit to browse.

tag.description: Only sheets with this topic tag: moments-in-history (Moments in History), inventions-and-discoveries (Inventions & Discoveries), faith (Faith), art (Art), natural-science (Natural Science), holidays-and-traditions (Holidays & Traditions).

date.description: Only the sheet(s) for this publish date, YYYY-MM-DD.

today.description: Only today's sheet(s), by the date in New York.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, for the next page.

tools.name: get_printable
tools.title: Get a printable
tools.description: Get one printable by the id from search_printables: its title, the day in history it marks, the short story printed with it, its color key, and links to print or download it.
